name: Adaptive Clustering with Error-Bisector Splitting
aliases: Cluster subdivision by positive/negative error centers
Splitting along bisector of c+ and c-
definition: A clustering algorithm that subdivides spatial clusters based on the spatial distribution of approximation errors (residuals) to minimize the number of clusters for a given error bound.
summary: Adaptive clustering with error-bisector splitting generates data-dependent cluster hierarchies using quadratic approximations and bisector splits to efficiently approximate surfaces with directional curvature.
